sentences: I measure the length and width of each room to calculate the total square footage.
I draw the floor plan on graph paper, marking walls, doors, and windows.
I check the local building codes to ensure the design meets all safety requirements.
I inspect the foundation for cracks and measure its depth with a tape measure.
I pour concrete into the wooden forms and smooth the surface with a trowel.
I frame the exterior walls with two-by-four lumber, spacing the studs sixteen inches apart.
I set the roof trusses in place and nail them to the top plates.
I install double-pane windows in the openings, sealing the edges with caulk.
I hang the interior doors on their hinges and check that they swing freely.
I build a staircase with twelve steps, each tread ten inches deep and seven inches high.
I run electrical wires through the studs and connect them to the circuit breaker panel.
I install the plumbing pipes for the sink and toilet, checking for leaks.
I assemble the HVAC ductwork and attach it to the air handler unit.
I place fiberglass insulation between the wall studs to improve thermal performance.
I screw drywall panels to the ceiling joists and cover the seams with joint compound.
I paint the exterior siding with two coats of weather-resistant latex paint.
I survey the building site with a transit level to determine the proper elevation.
I submit the permit application to the city planning department for review.
I review the blueprints with the architect to verify the dimensions of the load-bearing walls.
I calculate the load-bearing capacity of the steel beams using standard engineering tables.
